messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick thread — kicking off legal + marketplace + SI packaging for the co‑hosted SKU with Nova Systems. Target announce window: week of 2026-04-12. Need legal signoff on redistribution + embargo details, marketplace assets, and an SI integration checklist. Who can own each doc?

Sam (Legal): OK. I need the upstream model license and any partner addenda. Checklist (high level):
- confirm license (OSS vs permissive) + allowed redistribution
- attribution & NOTICE file inclusion
- export control (EAR/ITAR flags) — run through export@redwood
- commercial addendum for cohosted SKU (revenue split + reseller rights)
- KMS/HSM requirements for private/download distributions
- indemnity / warranty language for marketplace listing
- partner signatures (POA) before embargo lift
I can draft the addendum by Tue if you give me the base license and the partner contact.

Diego (Product): Adding tech constraints to legal asks:
- we will ship three artifact types: container image (server), raw model weights (float16), and a quantized ggml-compatible build.
- provide per-variant perf numbers (p50/p95 latency on H100 and A10) for the listing.
- manifest schema we want in the marketplace: name, variants, hash, quantization, recommended hw, sample inference config. Example:```
{
  "name": "open-nova-13b",
  "variants": ["float16","ggml-q8_0"],
  "hash": "sha256:...",
  "recommended": {"gpu": ["H100","A100"], "min_ram_gb": 32}
}
```
Diego: I can own the manifest and perf docs — ETA Fri.

Rachel (Marketplace): Listing requirements / publisher checklist:
- marketing blurb + 1 high-res logo + 2 screenshots or sample inference trace
- SKU id (we'll generate), supported deployment modes: hosted, download, private (VPC)
- pricing model options (per-token hosted + one-time download fee) — need partner's price guidance
- SLAs for Dedicated offerings (uptime target + incident contact)
- support & escalation path (partner SE contact + Redwood triage contact)
- embargoed listing in staging (we have a staging URL: https://marketplace.staging.redwood/partners)
I need assets by next Wed to hit the April 12 announce.

Owen (SolutionsEng): SI integration notes / checklist:
- compatibility matrix with common HW tiles: A100 (FP16), H100, AWS Trainium (if available).
- helm chart + values.yaml for our cohost orchestration (I'll add a snippet to the repo).
- automated smoke tests (sanity inference, kv-cache correctness, perf regression).
- package manifest must include a small self-test script: `run_smoke.sh` returning 0 on success.
- CI: we'll run a staging deploy using the partner's container image. Need access to partner registry or signed artifacts.
Owen: I can run the staging deploy on Wed/Thu — need the container image and keys.

Maya (Partnerships): Owners recap:
- Legal addendum & signoffs: Sam (due Tue)
- Manifest + perf docs: Diego (due Fri)
- Marketplace assets + pricing: Rachel (assets due Wed)
- SI staging deploy + helm: Owen (staging Wed/Thu)
Please reply with any blockers. Also: embargo policy — do we want a hard embargo lift on announce date or staggered (hosted first, downloads later)?

Sam (Legal): Prefer staggered: hosted listing + hosted API first, download allowed 48–72 hrs later after contract sign. That limits redistribution exposure. Will put that into the addendum.

Rachel (Marketplace): Staggered works for ops. We'll mark the listing "embargoed" in staging and set publish_time on the marketplace record. Need pricing numbers from partner by EOD Tue.

Owen (SolutionsEng): I need partner registry creds + sample config by EOD Tue. Also confirm whether downloads are blob-hosted (S3) or partner-hosted — affects KMS flow.

Diego (Product): One more ask for legal: we need to allow fallback routing in the cohost SKU — policy to route to a quantized variant if float16 variant is out of capacity. Sam: does that require special wording?

Sam (Legal): Yes — include an operational routing clause and a note that quantized variants may have different accuracy characteristics; partner must approve fallback policy in the addendum.

announce-bot: Calendar event created: "Co-host SKU: Legal + Marketplace + SI sync" Thu 09:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/events/abc123 :calendar:

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short doc linking legal draft, manifest template (Diego), and staging listing URL. If anyone can't hit the deadlines above, speak up now. :thumbsup:

Sam (Legal): LGTM.

Owen (SolutionsEng): I'll post a minimal helm.values snippet in the repo and tag staging when ready.

Rachel (Marketplace): Copy — will reserve the announce slot in the UI and set publish_time once legal signs off.

Diego (Product): Sending perf numbers + manifest by EOD Fri.

Maya (Partnerships): Great — thread closed unless blockers.
